1,319 maths questions
the standard test set everyone uses

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center;

span.p:
The small AI answers each one three times
the same question, three separate attempts,
allowed to try a different approach each time

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Did the three attempts
land on the same answer?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Keep that answer. Done.
Nothing leaves your machine.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center;

span.p:
These are the hard ones.
There is no answer to trust, so we
put them in order, starting with the
ones the AI sounded least sure about.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center;

span.p:
The bigger AI marks the working
It sees the question and the working.
It never sees the correct answer.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center;

span.p:
The small AI tries the question again
this time told which step went wrong,
and how the question should be read.
It is never told the answer.
